title: dryopteris acrostichoides
intro: Dryopteris acrostichoides, commonly known as Eastern Woodfern, is a type of fern that belongs to the Dryopteridaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in the treatment of various ailments such as wounds, skin infections, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Eastern Woodfern include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight off infections, and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
